insights.claim: U.S. Bancorp reported record Q3 2026 net revenue of $8 billion with expanding operating efficiency. The bank is diversifying fee income through capital markets expansion (targeting 10%+ of revenue), scaling high-yield deposits via strategic partnerships like the Amazon small business credit card ($1.7B in period-end loans), and rebuilding capital to resume stock buybacks. Net interest margin expanded to 2.84%, positioning the bank to benefit from higher reinvestment rates.
